Note the source that drove the assumption change.
Done when every changed assumption is recorded with old value, new value, and date.
verify: Check each changed assumption row has all three fields populated.
Pass when no assumption change is missing old value, new value, or date.

steps.title: Mark superseded briefings as superseded rather than deleting them
sop: Identify briefings superseded by this quarter's outputs.
Mark each as superseded and record which item supersedes it.
Leave the version history intact rather than deleting the prior item.
Done when every superseded briefing is marked and linked to its successor.
verify: Check superseded items are still retrievable and carry a successor link.
Pass when no superseded briefing has been deleted.

steps.title: Refresh the archive index in Confluence
sop: Update the archive index so it lists every item by quarter, line of business, and topic.
Add links from the index entries to the archived items.
Remove index entries for items withdrawn under retention.
Done when the index matches the archive contents exactly.
verify: Pick three topics and use the index to locate the corresponding briefings.
Pass when all three searches locate the correct item from the index.

steps.title: Apply the documented retention period to archive items
sop: List archive items that have passed the documented retention period.
Remove only those items and record the removal date and the approving owner.
Leave every item still within retention untouched.
Done when only past-retention items have been removed and each removal is logged.
verify: Check each removal in the log against the documented retention period.
Pass when no item was removed before its retention period expired.

steps.title: Review the archive and register currency with the Customer Insights Lead
sop: Review the archive index and assumptions register for currency to the latest quarter.
Challenge any assumption left unchanged that the evidence suggests has moved.
Record the review date and outcome on the register.
Done when the review is recorded and gaps are assigned for correction.
verify: Check the register carries a review date for the current quarter.
Pass when the Customer Insights Lead confirms the archive and register are current.

generic.Defined scope/population: All line and state cells in the market dataset where we hold appetite or a licence.
generic.In-scope period: The current market data period used for the share and white-space calculation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Our direct written premium, market denominator, and share populated per line and state cell.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Our premium in the share calculation reconciles to the finance reported written premium.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Share map published with the market data period, denominator source, and version stamped.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cells excluded for appetite or licensing logged with the exclusion reason recorded.
generic.Test population: The published market share and white-space map for the current period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every share figure states its market denominator source and reconciles to finance.
generic.Exception handling path: Market Research Analyst removes the cell from white space when licensing is absent.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Share and white-space map published by line and state with the denominator source stated.
generic.Evidence location: BI share map with the calculation workbook and market dataset extract in SharePoint.

steps.title: Calculate market share by line and state in the lakehouse
sop: Divide our direct written premium by the market denominator for each line and state cell.
State the denominator source explicitly against every cell.
Exclude cells where the denominator is unavailable rather than assuming a value.
Done when share is calculated for every cell with an available denominator.
verify: Reconcile our premium used in the calculation to the finance written premium report.
Pass when the premium reconciles and every share cell names its denominator source.

steps.title: Plot the market size versus our share grid in the BI platform
sop: Plot each line and state cell on a grid of market size against our share.
Size the plotted points by market premium so scale is visible.
Add reference lines for average share and material market size.
Done when the grid renders every eligible cell with reference lines.
verify: Check the plotted cell count matches the calculated share cell count.
Pass when no calculated cell is missing from the grid.

steps.title: Identify white-space cells with material size and below-average share
sop: Select cells with material market size and materially below-average share for us.
Record the size and share gap for each selected cell.
Rank the white-space cells by the premium opportunity they represent.
Done when the ranked white-space list is produced.
verify: Check each white-space cell meets both the size and the share criteria.
Pass when no listed cell fails either criterion.

steps.title: Overlay appetite and licensing status with the Distribution Analyst
sop: Overlay current appetite and state licensing status onto the white-space list.
Remove cells we cannot legally or practically write from the opportunity set.
Record the exclusion reason for each removed cell.
Done when the white-space list contains only writable cells.
verify: Check every remaining cell has a confirmed licence and appetite.
Pass when no unlicensed or out-of-appetite cell remains in the list.

steps.title: Draft the white-space read-out for the top opportunities
sop: Write a short read-out covering the top white-space opportunities and why they stand out.
State the market size, our share, and the gap for each opportunity named.
Note the evidence limitations behind each figure quoted.
Done when the read-out covers the top opportunities with figures and caveats.
verify: Trace each figure in the read-out back to the share calculation workbook.
Pass when every quoted figure traces to the workbook.

steps.title: Publish the share position map to the market intelligence workspace
sop: Publish the map, the white-space list, and the read-out together.
Stamp the publication with the market data period and denominator source.
Notify distribution and the Customer Insights Lead that the map is available.
Done when the map is published with its period and source stamps.
verify: Open the published map and check the period and denominator source display.
Pass when the Customer Insights Lead confirms both stamps are present and correct.

generic.Defined scope/population: The agreed market indicator set covering premium growth, rate, combined ratio, and capacity.
generic.In-scope period: The current quarter with the prior quarter reading shown alongside for comparison.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Current reading, prior reading, threshold, and source populated for every indicator.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Indicator count on the dashboard matches the agreed indicator set definition.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each quarterly refresh retained with the data as-of date displayed on the dashboard.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Indicators breaching a watch threshold logged with the movement explanation recorded.
generic.Test population: The refreshed market indicator dashboard for the current quarter.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every indicator has both readings, a threshold flag state, and an as-of date.
generic.Exception handling path: Market Research Analyst records a restatement note when an indicator definition changes.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dashboard refreshed for the quarter with as-of date and threshold flags visible.
generic.Evidence location: BI market indicator dashboard with the source workbook in SharePoint.

steps.title: Refresh the agreed indicator set in Excel from source publications
sop: Refresh market premium growth, rate change, combined ratio, capacity, and new-entrant activity.
Record the source and retrieval date for each refreshed indicator.
Hold any indicator whose source has not yet published rather than estimating it.
Done when every indicator is refreshed or marked as awaiting publication.
verify: Check each indicator carries a source and retrieval date.
Pass when no refreshed indicator lacks source metadata.

steps.title: Record current and prior-quarter readings side by side
sop: Place the current reading beside the prior-quarter reading for every indicator.
Calculate the movement between the two readings.
Check the prior reading matches what was published last quarter.
Done when both readings and the movement are recorded per indicator.
verify: Compare the prior readings against last quarter's published dashboard.
Pass when every prior reading matches the previously published value.

steps.title: Confirm indicator definitions are unchanged or record the restatement
sop: Compare each indicator definition against the definition used last quarter.
Record a restatement note where a definition or source basis has changed.
Restate the prior reading on the new basis where a change occurred.
Done when definitions are confirmed or restatements are recorded.
verify: Check every changed definition has a restatement note and a restated prior value.
Pass when no definition change is recorded without a restatement.

steps.title: Flag indicators breaching their watch thresholds
sop: Compare each current reading against its predefined watch threshold.
Flag every breach and write a short note explaining the movement.
Escalate breaches that change the outlook for a line to the briefing agenda.
Done when every breach is flagged and explained.
verify: Check each flagged indicator carries an explanatory note.
Pass when no flagged breach is left without an explanation.

steps.title: Refresh the market indicator dashboard in the BI platform
sop: Load the refreshed readings into the market indicator dashboard.
Confirm the data as-of date displays on the dashboard face.
Confirm the threshold flags render for the flagged indicators.
Done when the dashboard shows current readings, as-of date, and flags.
verify: Open the dashboard and compare displayed readings against the source workbook.
Pass when the dashboard values match the workbook and the as-of date shows.

steps.title: File the quarterly indicator pack in SharePoint
sop: File the indicator workbook, source extracts, and restatement notes for the quarter.
Link the filed pack from the dashboard so users can reach the detail.
Confirm the prior quarter pack remains available for comparison.
Done when the quarterly pack is filed and linked.
verify: Follow the dashboard link to the filed pack and open the workbook.
Pass when the link resolves and the workbook matches the dashboard quarter.

generic.Defined scope/population: Addressable premium by segment, line, and distribution channel within our appetite filters.

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total attainable premium reconciles against current plan volumes with gaps explained.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Estimate workbook retained with assumptions, sources, and a dated version stamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Opportunities dropped for appetite or licensing logged with the reason recorded.
generic.Test population: The addressable growth estimate set for the current planning horizon.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every opportunity carries three cases and a stated capture-rate assumption.
generic.Exception handling path: Market Research Analyst revises the capture rate when the plausibility check fails.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Estimates produced by segment, line, and channel with cases and stated assumptions.
generic.Evidence location: Estimate workbook in SharePoint with the BI opportunity view and market dataset extract.

steps.title: Apply appetite filters to the market dataset in the lakehouse
sop: Apply current appetite and licensing filters to the market size dataset.
Remove segments, lines, and states we cannot write from the addressable base.
Record every filter applied and the premium removed by it.
Done when the filtered addressable base is produced with filters logged.
verify: Check the removed premium equals the difference between raw and filtered market size.
Pass when the filter reconciliation balances.

steps.title: Estimate addressable premium by segment, line, and channel in Excel
sop: Split the filtered addressable base by segment, line of business, and distribution channel.
Record the basis used for each split where market data does not provide it directly.
Check the split premium sums back to the filtered addressable base.
Done when addressable premium exists for every segment, line, and channel cell.
verify: Sum the split cells and compare to the filtered addressable base.
Pass when the split reconciles to the base total.

steps.title: Apply and document the capture-rate assumption
sop: Apply the capture-rate assumption that converts addressable premium to attainable premium.
Document the basis for the capture rate using historical new-business performance.
Vary the capture rate by channel where the evidence supports a difference.
Done when attainable premium is calculated with the capture rate documented.
verify: Check the capture rate cites historical evidence rather than judgement alone.
Pass when every capture rate used carries a documented basis.

steps.title: Produce low, base, and high cases for each opportunity
sop: Produce low, base, and high cases by flexing the capture rate and market growth assumptions.
State which assumption drives the spread between the cases.
Avoid presenting any opportunity as a single-point estimate.
Done when all three cases exist for every opportunity.
verify: Check each opportunity has three distinct case values with low below high.
Pass when no opportunity is presented as a single point.

steps.title: Cross-check the total attainable estimate against plan volumes
sop: Compare the total attainable premium against current plan volumes by line and channel.
Explain any gap larger than the agreed plausibility tolerance.
Revise the capture rate where the comparison shows the estimate is implausible.
Done when the comparison is complete and material gaps are explained.
verify: Check each material gap has a written explanation or a revised assumption.
Pass when no material gap is left unexplained.

steps.title: Publish the estimates with assumptions on the face of the output
sop: List every assumption and its source on the face of the published output.
Publish the estimates to the BI platform and the market intelligence workspace.
Invite planners to challenge the assumptions before the estimates enter planning.
Done when the estimates are published with assumptions visible.
verify: Open the published output and check the assumption list is visible without opening the workbook.
Pass when every material assumption appears on the published output.

generic.Defined scope/population: Distribution and marketing leadership attending the market briefing review.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Minuted review with attendees, decisions, and follow-ups recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Minutes in the market intelligence workspace with the circulated briefing version attached.

steps.title: Circulate the briefing two business days before the review
sop: Send the market briefing to distribution and marketing leadership at least two business days ahead.
State the decisions the session needs to reach in the covering note.
Record the circulation date and the recipient list.
Done when the briefing is circulated with the decision list stated.
verify: Compare the circulation date against the review date.
Pass when circulation occurred at least two business days before the review.

steps.title: Walk leadership through market movements and share position
sop: Present market movements, our share position, and the quantified growth opportunities.
Use the BI reports live so leadership can interrogate the figures during the session.
Keep the presentation to the questions agreed in the scope note.
Done when all scope-note questions have been addressed in the session.
verify: Check every scope-note question was covered in the session record.
Pass when no scope-note question is left unaddressed.

steps.title: Capture leadership challenges and evidence requests
sop: Capture every challenge leadership raises against the findings during the session.
Note where further evidence is required before a decision can be taken.
Assign an owner and a response date to each evidence request.
Done when every challenge and evidence request is captured with an owner.
verify: Check each captured challenge has an owner and a response date.
Pass when no challenge is captured without both.

steps.title: Record decisions on opportunities to pursue this cycle
sop: Record the decision taken on each growth opportunity presented.
State the decision as pursue, defer, or decline with the rationale.
Name the team accountable for each pursued opportunity.
Done when every presented opportunity carries a recorded decision.
verify: Compare the decision list against the opportunities in the briefing pack.
Pass when every presented opportunity has a decision.

sop: Record who attended and who sent apologies.
Note any decision deferred because a required attendee was absent.
Arrange a follow-up for decisions that could not be taken.
Done when the attendee list and any deferrals are recorded.
verify: Compare the attendee list against the required decision-maker list.
Pass when every decision taken had its required decision-maker present.

sop: Write the minutes covering attendees, decisions, challenges, and follow-ups.
Attach the circulated briefing version to the minutes.
Circulate the minutes to attendees for correction within the agreed turnaround.
Done when the minutes are filed and circulated.
verify: Open the filed minutes and check all four content sections are present.
Pass when the Marketing Manager confirms the minutes are complete and circulated.

steps.title: Draft the briefing against the scope note questions
sop: Structure the briefing to answer each scope note question in turn.
State the answer first and the supporting evidence second for each question.
Log any question the evidence cannot answer as a stated gap.
Done when every scope question has an answer or a logged gap.
verify: Map the briefing sections against the scope note question list.
Pass when no scope question is missing an answer or a gap entry.

steps.title: Assemble market size, share, trend, and growth outputs into one pack
sop: Bring the market size, share position, trend impacts, and growth estimates into one pack.
Remove duplicated figures so a number appears once with one source.
State the as-of date for each incorporated output.
Done when all four outputs are assembled with as-of dates.
verify: Check each incorporated output appears once and carries an as-of date.
Pass when no figure appears twice with conflicting values.

steps.title: Write the implication for appetite, pricing, product, and channel
sop: Write the implication of each major finding for appetite, pricing, product, and channel.
State implications as decisions the business could take rather than observations.
Mark implications that need further analysis before they can be acted on.
Done when every major finding carries implications across the four areas.
verify: Check each major finding has an implication for all four areas or a stated reason it does not.
Pass when no major finding is left without implications.

steps.title: Peer-review the figures against the underlying workbooks
sop: Check every figure in the briefing against the underlying workbook it came from.
Raise every discrepancy found and hold the briefing until each is resolved.
Record the peer-review outcome with the reviewer name and date.
Done when peer review is complete and discrepancies are resolved.
verify: Check the peer-review record lists the figures checked and the discrepancies raised.
Pass when every raised discrepancy shows a resolution.

steps.title: Review the draft briefing with the Chief Marketing Officer
sop: Review the draft briefing for clarity of the answers and strength of the implications.
Challenge any implication that overstates what the evidence supports.
Record required changes before the briefing is finalised.
Done when the review is complete and required changes are recorded.
verify: Check every required change from the review has been applied to the final draft.
Pass when no required change is left unapplied.

steps.title: Version, date, and file the final briefing in the archive
sop: Apply the version number and date to the final briefing.
File the briefing in the market intelligence archive under the naming convention.
Mark any superseded briefing and link it to this issue.
Done when the final briefing is versioned, dated, and filed.
verify: Open the filed briefing and check the version, date, and peer-review record are attached.
Pass when the Chief Marketing Officer confirms the filed version is the approved one.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every superseded battlecard version withdrawn from the live field-facing library.

steps.title: Identify battlecard versions superseded by the new release

Record the move in the version index.
Done when every superseded card sits in the archive folder.

Pass when the live folder holds no superseded card.

steps.title: Stamp each archived card with version, publication, and withdrawal dates
sop: Stamp each archived card with its version number, publication date, and withdrawal date.
Apply the stamps in the document metadata as well as on the card face.
Confirm the stamps survive the move into the archive.
Done when all three stamps are present on every archived card.
verify: Open a sample of archived cards and inspect the three stamps.
Pass when every sampled card carries version, publication, and withdrawal dates.

steps.title: Attach the compliance review record to each archived version
sop: Attach the original compliance review record to each archived battlecard version.
Confirm the record names the reviewer, review date, and outcome.
Log any archived card whose compliance record cannot be located.
Done when every archived card carries its compliance review record or a logged gap.
verify: Check a sample of archived cards for an attached compliance record.
Pass when every sampled card has a record or an entry in the gap log.

steps.title: Update the version index in Confluence for retrievability
sop: Update the version index so archived cards are retrievable by competitor name and version.
Link each index row to the archived document.
Order the index so the version history for a competitor reads in sequence.
Done when the index lists every archived version with a working link.
verify: Search the index by competitor name and open two archived versions.
Pass when both searches return the correct archived card.

steps.title: Confirm archived cards are unreachable from the live CRM library link
sop: Check the CRM and enablement links pointing at the live battlecard folder.
Confirm no link resolves to an archived version.
Correct any link still pointing at a withdrawn card and record the correction.
Done when no live link resolves to an archived battlecard.
verify: Follow each live battlecard link from CRM and the enablement library.
Pass when every link opens only a current version.

generic.Defined scope/population: The priority competitors and the lines they are benchmarked against in this cycle.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Coverage, limits, endorsements, price position, and service proposition populated per competitor.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Competitors in the grid match the approved priority competitor list exactly.

steps.title: Build the comparison grid structure in Excel

Confirm the competitor rows match the approved priority competitor list.
Done when the grid structure covers every competitor and criterion.
verify: Compare the grid competitor rows to the approved priority list.

steps.title: Populate coverage and price evidence from the regulatory filing portal
sop: Pull filed forms and published rates for each competitor from the filing portal.

Record the filing reference and the as-of date against each cell populated.

verify: Check each coverage and price cell carries a filing reference.
Pass when no coverage or price cell is populated without a filing reference.

steps.title: Score our position against each competitor on the agreed criteria

Done when every competitor and criterion pair carries a score and evidence.
verify: Check the grid shows both winning and losing positions where the evidence supports them.
Pass when no criterion is scored without supporting evidence.

steps.title: Add the distribution and service perspective from the field
sop: Add the field view of each competitor service proposition and producer experience.
Distinguish field observation from documented evidence in the grid.
Flag where the field view contradicts the filed evidence.
Done when the field perspective is added and clearly labelled.
verify: Check field observations are labelled distinctly from filed evidence.
Pass when no field observation is presented as documented evidence.

sop: Read every comparative statement in the grid and confirm it is factually substantiated.

Record the substantiation source against each retained comparative statement.
Done when every retained comparative statement is substantiated.
verify: Sample comparative statements and request the substantiating evidence for each.
Pass when every sampled statement produces its evidence.

steps.title: Stamp as-of dates and publish the benchmark to SharePoint
sop: Stamp the as-of date on every competitor data point so stale comparisons are visible.
Publish the benchmark grid to the competitive intelligence workspace.
Note the next refresh date for the benchmark.

steps.title: Pull competitor rate and form filings from the regulatory filing portal
