steps.title: Check every comparative claim against its cited evidence
sop: Open each comparative claim and locate the cited evidence in the register.
Confirm the evidence supports the claim as written and is still current.
Mark claims where the evidence is missing, stale, or does not support the wording.
Done when every comparative claim has been checked against its evidence.
verify: Count claims checked against claims present on the submitted cards.
Pass when every claim on every card has been checked.

steps.title: Check content for misleading, disparaging, or unfair comparison
sop: Read the whole card for misleading, disparaging, or unfair comparison of a competitor.
Assess whether a reasonable producer could repeat the wording without misleading a customer.
Mark any wording that fails and state the required change.
Done when the fairness check is complete on every card.
verify: Check every marked wording carries a stated required change.
Pass when no marked item is left without a required change.

steps.title: Check coverage and price statements against filed forms and rates
sop: Check every statement about our coverage or price against the filed forms and rates.
Confirm the statement holds in each state the card will be used in.
Mark statements that are inconsistent or state-specific but presented as general.
Done when all coverage and price statements are checked against filings.
verify: Sample coverage and price statements and compare to the filed documents.
Pass when every sampled statement is consistent with the filings.

steps.title: Record reviewer, date, and outcome for each battlecard
sop: Record the reviewer name, review date, and outcome for each card.
Use the outcome values approved, approved with changes, or rejected.
Attach the review record to the specific card version reviewed.
Done when every card carries a completed review record.
verify: Filter the review records for cards missing an outcome.
Pass when the filter returns no cards.

steps.title: Return rejected or amended cards for rework and re-review
sop: Return rejected and amended cards to the author with the required changes.
Re-review each returned card once the changes have been applied.
Hold publication of any card until its re-review is approved.
Done when every returned card is re-reviewed and its outcome recorded.
verify: Check every returned card carries a re-review outcome before publication.
Pass when no card is published without a final approved outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: The propensity model version submitted for production approval and its permitted uses.
generic.In-scope period: The approval window up to the next mandatory review date set on the model record.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approver name, role, date, model version, and permitted use populated on the record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Model version in the production scoring job matches the approved version exactly.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation, bias testing, and monitoring plan attached to the approved version record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Approval conditions and restrictions logged against the model record with owners.
generic.Test population: The model approval record for the current propensity model version.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when no production scoring job runs against an unapproved model version.
generic.Exception handling path: Customer Insights Lead withholds approval and returns the model for further validation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approval record with approver, version, permitted use, and next review date.
generic.Evidence location: Model governance repository approval record with the validation pack in SharePoint.

steps.title: Confirm validation, bias testing, and monitoring plan are attached
sop: Check the model version record holds the validation results, bias testing, and monitoring plan.
Attach any missing artefact before the approval request is raised.
Confirm the artefacts refer to the version being submitted and not an earlier build.
Done when all three artefacts are attached to the submitted version.
verify: Open the version record and check for all three artefacts.
Pass when none of the three is missing.

steps.title: State the permitted use explicitly on the approval request
sop: State the approved use as campaign targeting and producer prioritisation.
State explicitly that the model must not be used for pricing, underwriting, or eligibility.
Record any conditions attached to the permitted use.
Done when the permitted use and prohibitions are written on the approval request.
verify: Read the approval request for the permitted use and the prohibition statement.
Pass when both are stated explicitly.

steps.title: Review the validation evidence with the Chief Marketing Officer
sop: Review the lift results, bias testing outcome, and the stated limitations.
Challenge any result that does not meet the agreed success criteria.
Decide approve, approve with conditions, or reject and record the reasoning.
Done when the approval decision and reasoning are recorded.
verify: Check the recorded decision cites the validation evidence reviewed.
Pass when the decision reasoning references the evidence.

steps.title: Record the approval in the model governance repository
sop: Record the approver name, role, date, and approved model version on the model record.
Record the permitted use and any conditions on the same record.
Link the approval to the validation and bias testing artefacts.
Done when the approval record is complete on the model version.
verify: Open the approval record and check every field is populated.
Pass when no approval field is left blank.

steps.title: Set the approval expiry or next mandatory review date
sop: Set the approval expiry or next mandatory review date on the model record.
Name the owner accountable for initiating the review.
Add the review to the team planning calendar.
Done when the review date and owner are recorded on the model record.
verify: Check the model record shows a future review date and a named owner.
Pass when both are present and the calendar entry exists.

steps.title: Confirm the production scoring job references the approved version
sop: Check the production scoring job configuration for the model version it calls.
Repoint the job at the approved version where it references a development build.
Record the job configuration check with the date performed.
Done when the production job references only the approved model version.
verify: Read the production job configuration and compare against the approved version.
Pass when the Chief Marketing Officer confirms only the approved version runs in production.

generic.Defined scope/population: Customers eligible for the propensity target definition within the training population.
generic.In-scope period: The observation window ending at the strict cut-off before the outcome horizon.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Label, observation date, and feature values populated on every training row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Positive and negative class counts sum to the total training row count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Training dataset snapshot retained with a version and date for reproducibility.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Features removed for leakage or PII logged with the removal reason recorded.
generic.Test population: The versioned training dataset built for the current propensity model.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when no post-outcome feature is present and positive-class volume meets the minimum.
generic.Exception handling path: Data Analyst rebuilds the dataset with a corrected cut-off when leakage is found.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Versioned training dataset with documented label definition and observation cut-off.
generic.Evidence location: Training dataset snapshot in the lakehouse with the catalog entry and build notes.

steps.title: Define the outcome label precisely and record it
sop: Define the outcome label such as purchasing an additional policy within 12 months of the observation date.
State which products count towards the label and which do not.
Record the definition in the model documentation before the build starts.
Done when the label definition is recorded and agreed.
verify: Read the definition and check it names the products and the horizon.
Pass when the definition is unambiguous on both.

steps.title: Build the training set with a strict observation cut-off in Snowflake
sop: Set the observation cut-off date and build features using only data available at that point.
Compute the label from the outcome window that follows the cut-off.
Record the cut-off date and outcome window in the build notes.
Done when the training set is built on the strict cut-off.
verify: Check a sample of feature values were available on or before the cut-off date.
Pass when no sampled feature value postdates the cut-off.

steps.title: Run the leakage check across the training feature set
sop: Test each feature for post-outcome information or direct encoding of the label.
Remove every feature that leaks outcome information and record the removal.
Rebuild the affected features on the correct window where possible.
Done when the leakage check is complete and leaking features are removed.
verify: Rerun the leakage check on the retained feature set.
Pass when the check returns no leaking feature.

steps.title: Confirm positive-class volume and document class balance
sop: Count the positive and negative class rows in the training set.
Compare positive volume against the minimum needed for stable training.
Document the class balance and any sampling applied to address it.
Done when class balance is documented and the minimum is met or escalated.
verify: Check positive and negative counts sum to the total training rows.
Pass when the counts reconcile and positive volume meets the minimum.

steps.title: Confirm restricted PII and protected characteristics are excluded
sop: Scan the training feature list against the restricted PII and protected characteristic lists.
Remove every match and record the exclusion with its reason.
Check known proxies are also removed from the feature set.
Done when no restricted or protected field remains in the training set.
verify: Rerun the scan on the final training feature list.
Pass when the scan returns no restricted or protected field.

steps.title: Snapshot and register the training dataset in the data catalog
sop: Snapshot the training dataset and assign it a version and date.
Register the snapshot in the data catalog with owner, lineage, and retention.
Link the snapshot to the model version it will train.
Done when the versioned snapshot is registered and linked.
verify: Open the catalog entry and confirm the version, date, and model link are present.
Pass when the Customer Insights Lead confirms the dataset is reproducible from the entry.

generic.Defined scope/population: The production propensity model whose measured lift has fallen below the agreed threshold.
generic.In-scope period: The consecutive monitoring periods over which the degradation is assessed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Measured lift, threshold, monitoring periods, and approver populated on the decision record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Monitoring periods cited in the decision match the periods in the monitoring dashboard.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Decision record retained with the triggering metric values and the decision date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Interim continue, restrict, or suspend decisions logged against the model record.
generic.Test population: The model refresh decision record for the degraded model version.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when degradation is confirmed across two consecutive periods before commissioning.
generic.Exception handling path: Customer Insights Lead suspends score use where degradation risks poor targeting outcomes.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Refresh decision recorded with triggering metric, approver, and a tracked work item.
generic.Evidence location: Model governance record with the BI monitoring history and the tracked work item link.

steps.title: Compare current decile lift against the minimum threshold in the BI dashboard
sop: Read the current top-decile lift from the model monitoring dashboard.
Compare it against the agreed minimum lift threshold for the model.
Record the measured value and the threshold in the decision record.
Done when the measured lift and threshold are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded lift against the dashboard value for the same period.
Pass when the recorded and dashboard values agree.

steps.title: Confirm the degradation persists across two consecutive monitoring periods
sop: Read the lift for the prior monitoring period from the dashboard history.
Confirm the breach appears in both periods rather than one.
Record both period values in the decision record.
Done when the two-period persistence is confirmed or the breach is shown as isolated.
verify: Check both recorded periods sit below the threshold.
Pass when persistence is evidenced across two consecutive periods.

steps.title: Assess the likely cause before commissioning the refresh
sop: Check whether feature availability, score distribution shift, or population change explains the drop.
Rule out a broken upstream feed before treating the model as degraded.
Record the assessed cause in the decision record.
Done when the likely cause is assessed and recorded.
verify: Check the assessment covers feature availability and distribution shift.
Pass when both have been checked and recorded.

steps.title: Record the refresh decision and approver in the model governance record
sop: Record the decision to refresh with the triggering metric and its values.
Record the approver name, role, and decision date.
Link the decision to the model version being refreshed.
Done when the decision record is complete and linked.
verify: Open the decision record and check the metric, approver, and date are present.
Pass when no field is left blank.

steps.title: Raise the refresh as a tracked work item with owner and target date
sop: Raise the model refresh as a tracked work item.
Assign a named owner and a target completion date.
Link the work item to the model governance decision record.
Done when the work item exists with an owner and target date.
verify: Open the work item and check owner, target date, and the governance link.
Pass when all three are present.

steps.title: Record the interim use decision for the current scores
sop: Decide whether to continue, restrict, or suspend use of the current scores during the refresh.
State the reasoning and the teams affected by the decision.
Notify marketing and distribution of the interim position.
Done when the interim use decision is recorded and communicated.
verify: Check the model record shows an explicit interim use decision.
Pass when no degraded model is left in use without a recorded interim decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: Customers in the top propensity deciles surfaced to their owning producer in CRM.
generic.In-scope period: The alert period the volume cap is applied over.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Score, decile, owning producer, and recommendation driver populated on every alert.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Alerts generated per producer stay within the configured volume cap for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rule configuration and sandbox test results retained with the activation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Suppressed customers logged with the suppression flag that excluded them.
generic.Test population: The alert population generated by the CRM rule in the sandbox and first live run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when no do-not-contact or opt-out customer appears in the alert population.
generic.Exception handling path: Marketing Specialist disables the rule and corrects the suppression logic before reactivation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Active alert rule with a documented volume cap and driver display on each alert.
generic.Evidence location: CRM rule configuration with the sandbox test record in the marketing workspace.

steps.title: Configure the CRM rule to surface top-decile customers to the owning producer
sop: Configure the rule to select customers in the top propensity deciles.
Route each alert to the producer who owns the customer relationship.
Set the alert to appear in the producer work queue rather than as email only.
Done when the rule selects top-decile customers and routes to the owning producer.
verify: Inspect the rule criteria and routing configuration in CRM.
Pass when the criteria match the agreed deciles and routing follows ownership.

steps.title: Apply the suppression filters for opt-out and complaint flags
sop: Add exclusions for do-not-contact, marketing opt-out, and complaint-in-progress flags.
Apply the exclusions inside the rule rather than downstream of it.
Record the suppression fields used in the rule documentation.
Done when all three suppression filters are applied within the rule.
verify: Query the alert population for records carrying any suppression flag.
Pass when the query returns zero records.

steps.title: Set the alert volume cap per producer per period
sop: Set the maximum number of alerts a producer receives per period.
Prioritise the highest scores when the cap truncates the list.
Confirm the cap keeps the queue workable for a typical producer.
Done when the volume cap is configured and documented.
verify: Check the alert count per producer in a test run against the cap.
Pass when no producer exceeds the configured cap.

steps.title: Configure the alert to display the recommendation driver
sop: Add the top driver of the recommendation to the alert display alongside the score.
Write the driver in business language a producer can repeat to a customer.
Avoid exposing raw model feature names on the alert.
Done when every alert shows a business-language driver.
verify: Open a sample of alerts and check the driver text is present and readable.
Pass when every sampled alert shows a business-language driver.

steps.title: Test the rule in the CRM sandbox against a sample account set
sop: Run the rule in the sandbox against a representative sample account set.
Confirm the expected customers surface and the unexpected ones do not.
Fix the criteria and retest where the results differ from expectation.
Done when the sandbox results match the expected population.
verify: Compare the sandbox alert list against the expected customer list.
Pass when the two lists match within the agreed tolerance.

steps.title: Activate the rule in production and confirm the first run
sop: Activate the alert rule in production CRM.
Monitor the first run for volume, suppression, and routing correctness.
Record the activation date and the first run results.
Done when the rule is active and the first run is verified.
verify: Read the first run output for suppression breaches and cap breaches.
Pass when the Distribution Analyst confirms no breach in the first run.

generic.Defined scope/population: The propensity use cases proposed for this build and the teams that will own them.
generic.In-scope period: The build cycle the criteria govern, up to first model approval.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Target outcome, measurement window, and minimum lift threshold populated per use case.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Use cases in the agreed document match those raised by marketing and distribution.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Criteria document versioned and dated with the written agreement attached.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Use cases rejected as prohibited logged with the reason and the deciding owner.
generic.Test population: The agreed propensity use case and success criteria document.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when no use case is approved for pricing, underwriting, or eligibility decisioning.
generic.Exception handling path: Customer Insights Lead rejects and records any use case that crosses the prohibited boundary.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Agreed use case document with a stated minimum lift threshold before use.
generic.Evidence location: Criteria document in SharePoint with the Confluence page and written agreement emails.

steps.title: List the intended propensity use cases with owning teams
sop: List the intended use cases covering cross-sell targeting, renewal save, and lead prioritisation.
Name the owning team for each use case.
Capture how each team would consume the score in their day-to-day work.
Done when every use case has an owning team and a consumption route.
verify: Check each use case names an owning team and a consumption route.
Pass when no use case lacks either.

steps.title: Define the target outcome and measurement window per use case
sop: Define the target outcome each use case is trying to move.
Set the measurement window over which the outcome will be observed.
Confirm the outcome is measurable in the existing reporting.
Done when every use case has a target outcome and measurement window.
verify: Check each outcome can be produced from existing reporting.
Pass when every outcome has a confirmed reporting source.

steps.title: Set the minimum acceptable model performance threshold
sop: Set the minimum top-decile lift the model must achieve before it can be used.
Base the threshold on what the use case needs to be worth running.
Record the threshold in the criteria document.
Done when the minimum lift threshold is set and recorded.
verify: Check the threshold is a specific numeric value rather than a qualitative statement.
Pass when the threshold is numeric and recorded.

steps.title: State the prohibited uses explicitly in the criteria document
sop: State that propensity scores must not be used for pricing, underwriting, or eligibility decisions.
Explain the consequence of a prohibited use so the boundary is understood.
Record any use case proposed and rejected on this basis.
Done when the prohibition and any rejections are written into the document.
verify: Read the document for the explicit prohibition statement.
Pass when the prohibition names pricing, underwriting, and eligibility.

steps.title: Confirm distribution can action the prioritisation use cases
sop: Confirm producers have the capacity and tooling to action the prioritisation use case.
Estimate the alert or list volume each use case would generate.
Flag use cases that would exceed field capacity for rescoping.
Done when field feasibility is confirmed for every prioritisation use case.
verify: Compare the estimated volumes against the field capacity estimate.
Pass when no approved use case exceeds field capacity.

steps.title: Obtain written agreement from marketing and distribution before build
sop: Circulate the criteria document to marketing and distribution for written agreement.
Hold the build start until both agreements are received.
File the agreements against the versioned document.
Done when both written agreements are held and filed.
verify: Check the file holds an explicit agreement from each team.
Pass when the Marketing Manager confirms both agreements are recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: All scored customers whose propensity score and decile are delivered to CRM.
generic.In-scope period: The current scoring run and the recurring refresh cycle that follows it.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Score, decile, and score-as-of date populated on every loaded CRM customer record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: CRM loaded record count reconciles to the scoring output within 0.5%.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Load run log and reconciliation record retained with the score-as-of date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records failing the load logged with the cause and the reload outcome.
generic.Test population: CRM customer records loaded in the current propensity score delivery run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass at load variance under 0.5% and zero raw features or restricted PII in the feed.
generic.Exception handling path: Data Analyst investigates the variance and reloads failed records before sign-off.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Score and decile populated with score-as-of date and a scheduled refresh job.
generic.Evidence location: CRM customer records with the load run log and reconciliation record in the lakehouse.

steps.title: Define the CRM delivery feed columns in the lakehouse
sop: Define the feed as customer key, propensity score, decile, and score-as-of date only.
Exclude raw model features and any restricted PII from the feed definition.
Record the feed column list in the delivery documentation.
Done when the feed definition contains only the four approved columns.
verify: Compare the feed column list against the approved definition.
Pass when no additional column appears in the feed.

steps.title: Load the score and decile onto the CRM customer record
sop: Run the load of score, decile, and score-as-of date onto CRM customer records.
Record loaded, failed, and skipped record counts in the run log.
Reload failed records after fixing the cause.
Done when the load completes and failures are resolved or logged.
verify: Read the run log counts and check failures are resolved.
Pass when no unresolved failure remains.

steps.title: Reconcile the CRM loaded count to the scoring output
sop: Count CRM records holding a current score and compare to the scoring output count.
Calculate the variance and investigate anything above 0.5%.
Record the reconciliation with the run date.
Done when the reconciliation is recorded and variances explained.
verify: Recompute the variance from the recorded counts.
Pass when the variance is under 0.5% or fully explained.

steps.title: Set the score field read-only for marketing and sales users
sop: Set field-level security so marketing and sales users can view but not edit the score fields.
Confirm the fields appear on the layouts those users work from.
Test the permission under both user profiles.
Done when both profiles can read the score and neither can edit it.
verify: Attempt an edit of the score field under a sales user profile.
Pass when the edit is blocked and the value remains visible.

steps.title: Schedule the score refresh and flag stale scores on failure
sop: Schedule the recurring score refresh at the agreed cadence.
Configure a visible stale marker on the record when a refresh fails.
Set failure alerting to the Data Analyst.
Done when the schedule, stale marker, and alerting are all configured.
verify: Simulate a failed refresh in the sandbox and inspect the record display.
Pass when the stale marker appears and the alert fires.

steps.title: Confirm no raw features or restricted PII reached CRM
sop: Inspect the loaded CRM fields for raw model features or restricted PII.
Remove any field that should not have been delivered and record the removal.
Confirm the feed definition is corrected so the field is not reloaded.
Done when only the approved fields exist on the CRM record.
verify: Query the CRM propensity fields for any unapproved column.
Pass when the query returns only score, decile, and score-as-of date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The propensity model version being documented and the population it was trained on.
generic.In-scope period: The training snapshot period and the monitoring frequency the plan sets.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Purpose, permitted use, target definition, limitations, and drivers all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documented training population count matches the training dataset snapshot count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Documentation stored against the model version with a date and author recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Known limitations and poor-performance conditions logged with the mitigation stated.
generic.Test population: The model documentation attached to the current approved model version.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the documentation covers assumptions, limitations, drivers, and monitoring plan.
generic.Exception handling path: Data Analyst completes the missing section before the model goes for approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Documentation stored against the model version covering all four required areas.
generic.Evidence location: Model governance repository documentation entry with the Confluence detail page.

steps.title: Document the model purpose, permitted use, and target definition
sop: Write the model purpose and the permitted uses agreed in the criteria document.
Restate the target definition and the observation and outcome windows.
Describe the population the model was trained on and its size.
Done when purpose, permitted use, target, and population are documented.
verify: Compare the documented target and population against the training dataset record.
Pass when the documentation matches the training dataset.

steps.title: Document the key assumptions and known limitations
sop: List the key assumptions the model relies on.
State where the model is expected to perform poorly and why.
Note the mitigation or restriction applied to each limitation.
Done when assumptions and limitations are documented with mitigations.
verify: Check each limitation carries a mitigation or a stated restriction.
Pass when no limitation is listed without either.

steps.title: Document the top score drivers in business language
sop: Extract the top drivers of the score from the model output.
Translate each driver into business language a producer could use.
Avoid presenting the driver as a causal claim about the customer.
Done when the top drivers are documented in business language.
verify: Read the driver descriptions for model jargon and causal overstatement.
Pass when the descriptions are jargon-free and non-causal.

steps.title: Document the monitoring plan with metrics and thresholds
sop: Document the monitoring metrics, thresholds, and frequency for the model.
Name the owner accountable for running the monitoring.
State what happens when a threshold is breached.
Done when metrics, thresholds, frequency, owner, and breach action are documented.
verify: Check all five monitoring plan elements are present.
Pass when none of the five is missing.

steps.title: Peer-review the documentation for completeness
sop: Review the documentation against the required content list.
Raise gaps where a section is present but not usable by a reader.
Record the review outcome with the reviewer name and date.
Done when the review is complete and gaps are recorded.
verify: Check every raised gap has been closed in the final documentation.
Pass when no raised gap remains open.

steps.title: Store the documentation against the model version in the repository
sop: Attach the documentation to the model version record in the governance repository.
Link the Confluence detail page from the repository entry.
Confirm the documentation version matches the model version.
Done when the documentation is attached and version-matched.
verify: Open the model version record and check the documentation link resolves.
Pass when the Customer Insights Lead confirms the documentation matches the version.

generic.Defined scope/population: All customers in the eligible propensity population receiving policy and behaviour features.
generic.In-scope period: The observation window ending at the training cut-off date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy, payment, and engagement features populated or defaulted on every customer row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Feature table row count matches the eligible customer population count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Feature build script committed with the peer reviewer and the build date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Excluded proxies and protected characteristics logged with the exclusion test result.
generic.Test population: The engineered feature set for the current propensity model build.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when no protected characteristic or documented proxy remains in the feature set.
generic.Exception handling path: Data Analyst removes the offending feature and reruns the build before training.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Peer-reviewed build script in version control with a documented feature dictionary.
generic.Evidence location: Feature table in the lakehouse with the build script and review record in version control.

steps.title: Build policy history features from the policy administration platform
sop: Build tenure, product count, coverage limits, endorsement activity, and lapse history per customer.
Aggregate policy rows to customer level using the customer master ID.
Record the source table and window for each feature in the dictionary.
Done when all policy history features exist at customer level.
verify: Recompute one policy feature for a sample customer from the source policy records.
Pass when the recomputation matches the feature value.

steps.title: Build payment and billing behaviour features in Snowflake
sop: Build payment method, late payment counts, and reinstatement history features.
Use only billing events observable before the training cut-off.
Record the window and the default applied where a customer has no billing history.
Done when payment behaviour features exist for every customer row.
verify: Check the maximum billing event date used is on or before the cut-off.
Pass when no billing event postdates the cut-off.

steps.title: Build engagement features from service, portal, and quote activity
sop: Build service contact, portal usage, and quote activity features over the observation window.
Distinguish inbound service contacts from outbound marketing contacts.
Record the window definition for each engagement feature.
Done when engagement features are built across all three activity sources.
verify: Check each engagement feature carries a documented window definition.
Pass when no engagement feature is missing its window definition.

steps.title: Run the protected characteristic and proxy exclusion test
sop: Test the feature set against the protected characteristic list and the known proxy list.
Remove every match and document the exclusion test result.
Check derived features do not reconstruct a protected characteristic.
Done when the exclusion test is complete and documented.
verify: Rerun the exclusion test on the final feature set.
Pass when the test returns no protected characteristic or documented proxy.

steps.title: Publish the feature dictionary for the propensity model
sop: Publish the dictionary listing every feature with its source, window, and transformation.
Add the business meaning of each feature so drivers can be explained later.
Version the dictionary alongside the feature table.
Done when the dictionary covers every feature in the set.
verify: Compare the dictionary entry count against the feature table column count.
Pass when every feature column has a dictionary entry.

steps.title: Peer-review the feature build code and record the reviewer
sop: Review the feature build code against the dictionary and the exclusion test.
Raise findings on undocumented transformations and hard-coded values.
Record the review outcome and commit the reviewed script to version control.
Done when the reviewed script is committed with the reviewer recorded.
verify: Open the version control record and check the reviewer and date are present.
Pass when the committed script carries a completed review record.

generic.Defined scope/population: The eligible scoring population for the propensity-to-buy use case and its exclusions.
generic.In-scope period: The outcome horizon over which the purchase event is defined.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Business decision, target event, horizon, and eligible population all stated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Eligible population count after exclusions reconciles to the customer base count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Framing document versioned and dated with the agreement record attached.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Excluded groups logged with the exclusion reason and the deciding owner.
generic.Test population: The documented propensity-to-buy use case framing.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the target event, horizon, and eligible population are all unambiguous.
generic.Exception handling path: Customer Insights Lead reworks the framing when the outcome is not observable in data.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Framing documented with target event, horizon, and eligible population defined.
generic.Evidence location: Framing document in SharePoint with the Confluence page and the agreement record.

steps.title: State the business decision the score will support
sop: State the specific business decision the propensity score will support.
Name who will act on the score and in which system they will see it.
Confirm the decision is one the score can legitimately inform.
Done when the decision and the actor are stated.
verify: Check the stated decision falls inside the permitted use boundary.
Pass when the decision is not a pricing, underwriting, or eligibility decision.

steps.title: Define the target event and which products count as a purchase
sop: Define the target event precisely as a purchase of a named product set.
State the horizon over which the purchase must occur to count.
Exclude renewals and endorsements from the definition where they are not purchases.
Done when the target event and horizon are defined unambiguously.
verify: Read the definition and test it against three example customer scenarios.
Pass when all three scenarios resolve to a clear label.

steps.title: Define the eligible scoring population and its exclusions
sop: Define the eligible scoring population for the use case.
List the exclusions covering recently lapsed, do-not-contact, and out-of-scope accounts.
Record the reason for each exclusion.
Done when the eligible population and every exclusion are documented.
verify: Check the eligible population count reconciles to the base less the exclusions.
Pass when the population arithmetic balances.

steps.title: Confirm the outcome is observable with sufficient history
sop: Check the target event can be identified in the policy and billing data.
Confirm there is enough history to build a training set on the chosen horizon.
Escalate for rescoping where the history is insufficient.
Done when observability and history sufficiency are confirmed.
verify: Count observed target events in the available history.
Pass when the observed event count meets the minimum for training.

steps.title: Review the framing with the Marketing Manager
sop: Review the framing for fit with the marketing activity it will drive.
Challenge any definition that would produce targets marketing cannot action.
Record required changes and the agreement once they are applied.
Done when the review is complete and agreement is recorded.
verify: Check every required change from the review has been applied.
Pass when the Marketing Manager records agreement on the final framing.

steps.title: Publish the framing document to the analytics workspace
sop: Publish the framing document with decision, target event, horizon, and population.
Version and date the document.
Link the framing to the model build and the criteria document.
Done when the framing is published, versioned, and linked.
verify: Open the published document and check all four content elements are present.
Pass when none of the four is missing.

generic.Defined scope/population: The production propensity model scores and the outcomes realised against them.
generic.In-scope period: The current monitoring period compared against the model build baseline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Score distribution, decile conversion, lift, and feature null rates populated per period.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Scored population in monitoring reconciles to the production scoring run count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each monitoring period result retained with the run date and model version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Threshold breaches and broken feature feeds logged with the action taken.
generic.Test population: The production model scores and outcomes for the current monitoring period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when top-decile lift meets the agreed threshold and no period is left unmeasured.
generic.Exception handling path: Data Analyst notifies the model owner and raises a refresh assessment on breach.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Live dashboard showing distribution, decile conversion, and lift against threshold.
generic.Evidence location: Model monitoring dashboard in the BI platform with results filed in the model repository.

steps.title: Compare current score distribution against the build baseline
sop: Extract the current score distribution from the production scoring output.
Compare it against the distribution recorded at model build.
Flag material shift in the distribution shape or mean.
Done when the distribution comparison is produced and flagged.
verify: Check the comparison uses the baseline stored against the approved model version.
Pass when the baseline matches the model version in production.

steps.title: Measure realised conversion by propensity decile in the lakehouse
sop: Join realised purchase outcomes to the scored population by decile.
Measure conversion in each decile over the defined outcome window.
Compare the realised ordering against the predicted ordering.
Done when decile conversion is measured for every decile.
verify: Check conversion is reported for all ten deciles.
Pass when no decile is missing a conversion figure.

steps.title: Track top-decile lift against the agreed threshold over time
sop: Calculate top-decile lift for the period from the realised conversion.
Plot the lift trend against the agreed minimum threshold.
Flag the period where lift falls below the threshold.
Done when lift is calculated, plotted, and compared to the threshold.
verify: Recompute the lift from the decile conversion figures.
Pass when the recomputed lift matches the reported value.

steps.title: Check input feature availability and null rates each run
sop: Check the null rate of every input feature in the scoring run.
Compare against the null rates at model build to catch a broken upstream feed.
Raise a data incident where a feature has degraded materially.
Done when feature null rates are checked and incidents raised.
verify: Check every input feature has a recorded null rate for the run.
Pass when no input feature is missing its null rate.

steps.title: Publish the monitoring results to the model monitoring dashboard
sop: Load the distribution, decile conversion, lift, and null rate results to the dashboard.
Show the threshold line so breaches are visible at a glance.
Display the monitoring period and model version on the dashboard.
Done when the dashboard shows all four result sets for the period.
verify: Open the dashboard and check all four result sets render for the period.
Pass when no result set is missing from the dashboard.

steps.title: Notify the model owner of any threshold breach
sop: Review the monitoring results and identify any threshold breach.
Notify the model owner and record the notification in the model repository.
Raise a refresh assessment where the breach persists.
Done when every breach is notified and recorded.
verify: Check every breached metric has a recorded notification.
Pass when no breach is left without a notification record.

generic.Defined scope/population: The eligible customer population scored by the approved propensity model.
generic.In-scope period: The scoring snapshot the run is based on, stamped as the score-as-of date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Score, decile, model version, and score-as-of date populated on every scored row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Scored record count reconciles to the eligible population with exclusions explained.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Run log retained with run date, model version, and record counts.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unscored eligible customers logged with the recorded exclusion reason.
generic.Test population: The decile-ranked propensity score table from the current run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when deciles hold approximately equal shares and no eligible customer is unscored.
generic.Exception handling path: Data Analyst reprocesses the unscored records or records the exclusion reason.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Decile-ranked score table in the governed schema with run log and score-as-of date.
generic.Evidence location: Governed analytics schema score table with the run log and spot-check workbook.

steps.title: Assemble the eligible customer population for scoring
sop: Apply the documented eligibility rules and exclusions to the customer base.
Record the eligible population count for the run.
Record the count removed by each exclusion rule.
Done when the eligible population is assembled with exclusion counts logged.
verify: Check base count less exclusions equals the eligible population count.
Pass when the population arithmetic balances.

steps.title: Run the approved model against the eligible population in Snowflake
sop: Run the approved model version against the eligible population.
Record the run date, model version, and scored record count in the run log.
Rerun failed partitions rather than accepting a partial scoring.
Done when the scoring run completes across the eligible population.
verify: Compare the scored count against the eligible population count.
Pass when the two counts agree or the difference is fully logged.

steps.title: Assign propensity deciles across the scored population
sop: Rank the scored population and assign deciles so each holds roughly an equal share.
Handle score ties consistently so decile boundaries are reproducible.
Record the decile boundary score values for the run.
Done when every scored customer carries a decile.
verify: Count records per decile and compare the shares.
Pass when each decile holds approximately one tenth of the scored population.

steps.title: Investigate unscored eligible customers
sop: List eligible customers with no score after the run.
Investigate the cause and rescore where the cause can be fixed.
Record an explicit exclusion reason for any customer left unscored.
Done when no eligible customer is unscored without a recorded reason.
verify: Query the output for eligible customers without a score.
Pass when every returned record carries a recorded reason.

steps.title: Spot-check top and bottom decile customers for face validity
sop: Sample customers from the top and bottom deciles and review their profiles.
Check the top-decile sample looks plausibly likely to buy the target product.
Record any obvious mis-targeting found and refer it back before release.
Done when the spot-check is complete and findings are recorded.
verify: Count implausible cases found in the sampled records.
Pass when implausible cases sit within the agreed tolerance.

steps.title: Store the scored output in the governed analytics schema
sop: Write the scored output with score, decile, model version, and score-as-of date.
Store it in the governed analytics schema with the standard access controls.
Link the output table to the run log entry.
Done when the output is stored and linked to the run log.
verify: Open the output table and check all four required columns are populated.
Pass when the Customer Insights Lead confirms the table and run log are complete.

generic.Defined scope/population: The versioned training dataset split into train and holdout for the propensity model.
generic.In-scope period: The training snapshot period and the outcome window used to label the data.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: AUC or Gini, top-decile lift, and bias test results populated for the holdout.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Train and holdout row counts sum to the training dataset row count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Model version, metrics, and holdout results recorded in the governance repository.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Bias test findings logged with the mitigation or acceptance decision recorded.
generic.Test population: The holdout sample scored by the trained candidate model.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when metrics are reported on the holdout and decile lift ordering is monotonic.
generic.Exception handling path: Data Analyst retrains or reframes the model when the holdout metrics fail the criteria.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Holdout validation results with lift table and bias test outcomes recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Model governance repository version record with the training notebook in the lakehouse.

steps.title: Split the training data into train and holdout sets
sop: Split the versioned training dataset into train and holdout sets on the agreed ratio.
Ensure no customer appears in both sets.
Record the split ratio, seed, and row counts.
Done when the split is complete with counts recorded.
verify: Check for customer keys present in both the train and holdout sets.
Pass when no customer key appears in both.

steps.title: Train the candidate model on the training set in Snowflake
sop: Train the candidate model on the training set with a fixed random seed.
Record the hyperparameters and the training run date.
Save the candidate model artefact for holdout scoring.
Done when the candidate model is trained and the artefact saved.
verify: Check the recorded hyperparameters and seed allow the run to be reproduced.
Pass when a rerun with the recorded settings reproduces the model.

steps.title: Score the holdout and record AUC or Gini and top-decile lift
sop: Score the holdout set with the trained candidate model.
Record AUC or Gini and top-decile lift measured on the holdout only.
Do not report any performance metric from the training sample.
Done when the holdout metrics are recorded.
verify: Check every reported metric is labelled as holdout-derived.
Pass when no metric is reported from the training sample alone.

steps.title: Produce the holdout decile lift table and check monotonic ordering
sop: Produce the decile lift table on the holdout set.
Check conversion decreases monotonically from the top decile to the bottom.
Investigate and record any inversion in the ordering.
Done when the lift table is produced and ordering is assessed.
verify: Read the decile conversion sequence for inversions.
Pass when the ordering is monotonic or every inversion is explained.

steps.title: Run fairness and bias testing across the monitored groups
sop: Run the agreed fairness and bias tests across the monitored groups.
Record the test results and any disparity found.
Refer material disparity to the Customer Insights Lead before proceeding.
Done when bias testing is complete and results are recorded.
verify: Check every monitored group has a recorded test result.
Pass when no monitored group is missing its result.

steps.title: Record the model version, metrics, and holdout results in the repository
sop: Create the model version record with hyperparameters, metrics, and holdout results.
Attach the lift table and the bias testing results to the version.
Confirm the record is sufficient for someone else to reproduce the validation.
Done when the version record is complete with all artefacts attached.
verify: Open the version record and check metrics, lift table, and bias results are attached.
Pass when the Customer Insights Lead confirms all three are present.

generic.Defined scope/population: The validated propensity model version and the sample of high-scoring customers reviewed.
generic.In-scope period: The validation window before the model is submitted for production approval.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Holdout lift, driver review outcome, and bias sign-off populated on the record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sampled high-scoring customers reviewed match the agreed sample size.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation record retained with the model version and the review date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Mis-targeted high scorers logged with the explanation or the corrective action.
generic.Test population: The validation record and reviewed customer sample for the current model version.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when holdout lift meets the agreed threshold and drivers are judged plausible.
generic.Exception handling path: Customer Insights Lead returns the model for rework when the threshold is not met.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Validation record confirming lift, driver plausibility, and business applicability.
generic.Evidence location: Validation record in the model repository with the BI review report in SharePoint.

steps.title: Confirm holdout lift meets the agreed minimum threshold
sop: Read the holdout top-decile lift from the model version record.
Compare it against the minimum threshold in the success criteria document.
Record whether the threshold is met and by what margin.
Done when the lift comparison is recorded.
verify: Check the compared threshold matches the agreed criteria document.
Pass when the threshold used is the agreed one and the result is recorded.

steps.title: Review the top score drivers with marketing and distribution
sop: Walk the top score drivers through with marketing and distribution.
Confirm each driver is business-plausible and explainable to a producer.
Record any driver the business judges implausible.
Done when every top driver has a plausibility judgement recorded.
verify: Check each top driver carries a recorded plausibility judgement.
Pass when no top driver is left unjudged.

steps.title: Review a sample of high-scoring customers for mis-targeting
sop: Sample high-scoring customers and check their current product holdings.
Identify customers who already hold the target product.
Explain or correct each mis-targeted case found.
Done when the sample review is complete and cases are explained.
verify: Check every mis-targeted case in the sample carries an explanation or correction.
Pass when no unexplained mis-targeted case remains in the sample.

steps.title: Confirm bias testing results are acceptable
sop: Review the fairness and bias testing results against the agreed acceptance position.
Record the reviewer sign-off or the required mitigation.
Hold validation open until any required mitigation is applied.
Done when the bias results are signed off or mitigation is recorded.
verify: Check the bias review carries a named reviewer and a sign-off outcome.
Pass when both are present on the record.

steps.title: Record conditions of use arising from validation
sop: Record any conditions of use arising from the validation findings.
State segments or situations where the score should not be relied on.
Attach the conditions to the model version record.
Done when the conditions of use are recorded against the version.
verify: Open the version record and check the conditions of use are attached.
Pass when the conditions are present and specific.

steps.title: Record the validation outcome before submitting for approval
sop: Record the overall validation outcome with the evidence behind it.
Submit the model for production approval only where validation passed.
Return the model for rework where the outcome is a fail.
Done when the validation outcome is recorded and the next step taken.
verify: Read the validation record for outcome, evidence, and next step.
Pass when the Marketing Manager confirms the outcome is evidenced.

generic.Defined scope/population: Non-renewals and mid-term cancellations across the in-scope lines and segments.
generic.In-scope period: The churn observation period agreed for the analysis.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reason code, churn type, and driver measures populated on every churn record analysed.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Churn record count reconciles to the policy administration non-renewal report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Analysis workbook retained with the data as-of date and version stamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Churn records with missing or generic reason codes logged with the follow-up action.
generic.Test population: The churn population for the analysis period across the in-scope lines.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every stated driver carries a quantified effect and a voluntary split.
generic.Exception handling path: Data Analyst removes the driver claim when the quantified evidence does not support it.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Churn driver analysis with quantified effect per driver and voluntary split.
generic.Evidence location: Analysis workbook in SharePoint with the BI churn report and lakehouse extract.

steps.title: Classify non-renewals and cancellations by reason code
sop: Extract non-renewals and mid-term cancellations for the period from the lakehouse.
Classify each by its recorded reason code.
Identify records where the reason code is missing or generic.
Done when every churn record is classified or flagged as unclassified.
verify: Reconcile the churn record count to the policy administration non-renewal report.
Pass when the counts agree within the agreed tolerance.

steps.title: Separate voluntary from involuntary churn
sop: Split churn into voluntary lapse, non-payment cancellation, and carrier-initiated non-renewal.
Apply the documented rules so the split is reproducible.
Report the volume and premium in each category.
Done when every churn record carries a voluntary or involuntary classification.
verify: Sum the three categories and compare to the total churn count.
Pass when the three categories reconcile to the total.

steps.title: Test the association between churn and candidate drivers
sop: Test churn against premium change at renewal, claims experience, service contacts, and payment issues.
Measure the strength of association for each candidate driver.
Record the method used so the result can be reproduced.
Done when every candidate driver has a measured association.
verify: Check each candidate driver has a recorded association measure and method.
Pass when no candidate driver is reported without both.

steps.title: Quantify the churn difference by rate increase band
sop: Group customers into rate increase bands at renewal.
Calculate the churn rate for each band and compare against the no-increase group.
Report the difference in percentage points per band.
Done when churn rates are quantified for every rate increase band.
verify: Check the band population counts sum to the renewal population.
Pass when the band counts reconcile to the renewal base.

steps.title: Identify the segments most affected by each driver
sop: Break each top driver down by customer segment and product.
Identify the segments where the driver has the strongest effect.
Check segment volumes are large enough to report on.
Done when the segment breakdown is complete for the top drivers.
verify: Check no segment result is reported below the minimum volume threshold.
Pass when every reported segment meets the minimum volume.

steps.title: Document the top churn drivers with supporting evidence
sop: Document the top churn drivers with the quantified effect and affected segments.
Remove any driver claim that the evidence does not support.
Publish the findings to the analytics workspace with the data as-of date.
Done when the documented drivers are published with evidence.
verify: Trace each documented driver to its quantified evidence in the workbook.
Pass when every driver traces to quantified evidence.

generic.Defined scope/population: In-force policyholders eligible for churn scoring within the defined prediction horizon.
generic.In-scope period: The observation window and the churn prediction horizon such as the next 90 days.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Churn score, at-risk flag, and score-as-of date populated on every scored record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Scored record count reconciles to the eligible in-force policyholder count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Model version, holdout results, and run log retained in the governance repository.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records excluded from scoring logged with the exclusion reason recorded.
generic.Test population: The churn-risk scores written to the governed analytics schema for the current run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when holdout lift is recorded and no pricing or underwriting process consumes the score.
generic.Exception handling path: Data Analyst blocks the downstream consumer and escalates any prohibited use found.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Validated churn scores in the governed schema with holdout lift recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Governed analytics schema score table with the model repository version record.

steps.title: Define the churn event and prediction horizon
sop: Define the churn event such as non-renewal within the next 90 days.
State whether non-payment cancellation counts as churn for this model.
Record the definition and horizon in the model documentation.
Done when the churn event and horizon are recorded.
verify: Test the definition against three example policy scenarios.
Pass when all three resolve to an unambiguous label.

steps.title: Build churn features from payment, service, and renewal data
sop: Build features from payment behaviour, service contact history, engagement, and claims.
Add the renewal premium change feature for policies in the renewal window.
Use only data observable before the prediction window opens.
Done when the churn feature set is built on the correct observation window.
verify: Check the latest event date used precedes the prediction window.
Pass when no feature uses data from inside the prediction window.

steps.title: Train and validate the churn model on a holdout period in Snowflake
sop: Train the churn model and validate it on a holdout period rather than a random split alone.
Record the lift in the highest-risk decile on the holdout.
Record the model version, hyperparameters, and run date.
Done when the holdout validation is complete and recorded.
verify: Check the reported lift is measured on the holdout period.
Pass when no metric is reported from the training period alone.

steps.title: Confirm the score is restricted to retention outreach use
sop: State that the churn score is for retention outreach only.
Confirm no pricing, non-renewal, or underwriting process consumes the score.
Record the permitted use on the model governance record.
Done when the permitted use is recorded and prohibited consumers are confirmed absent.
verify: List the downstream consumers of the churn score table.
Pass when no listed consumer is a pricing, underwriting, or non-renewal process.

steps.title: Score the in-force population and set the at-risk flag
sop: Score the eligible in-force policyholder population with the validated model.
Set the at-risk flag using the agreed score cut-off.
Record the run date, model version, and record counts.
Done when every eligible policyholder carries a score and flag.
verify: Compare the scored count against the eligible in-force count.
Pass when the counts agree or the differences are logged.

steps.title: Write the scores to the governed analytics schema
sop: Write the churn score, at-risk flag, and score-as-of date to the governed schema.
Apply the standard access controls to the score table.
Register the table and link it to the model version record.
Done when the scores are written, controlled, and registered.
verify: Open the score table and check all three columns are populated.
Pass when the Customer Insights Lead confirms the table and model link are correct.

generic.Defined scope/population: Customers eligible for retention or cross-sell outreach after suppression is applied.
generic.In-scope period: The campaign period the target lists are generated for.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rank, churn risk, value, propensity, and inclusion reason populated on every list row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: List volume matches the capacity cap agreed with distribution and marketing.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each list stamped with generation date, model versions used, and owning team.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Suppressed customers logged with the suppression category that removed them.
generic.Test population: The prioritised retention and cross-sell target lists released for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when no opted-out or do-not-contact customer appears on a released list.
generic.Exception handling path: Customer Insights Lead withdraws the list and reruns suppression when a breach is found.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Prioritised lists generated with suppression applied and generation date recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Target list tables in the lakehouse with the CRM load record and generation log.

steps.title: Rank customers by combined churn risk and value in the lakehouse
sop: Combine churn risk and customer value into the retention ranking.
Order so the highest-value at-risk customers appear first.
Record the weighting used to combine risk and value.
Done when the retention ranking is produced with the weighting recorded.
verify: Check the top of the ranking holds high-value and high-risk customers.
Pass when the ranking behaves as the recorded weighting predicts.

steps.title: Rank cross-sell candidates by propensity and expected premium
sop: Rank cross-sell candidates by propensity score and expected premium from the coverage-gap analysis.
Attach the recommended next-best product to each candidate.
Exclude candidates ineligible for the recommended product.
Done when the cross-sell ranking is produced with products attached.
verify: Check each candidate carries a product they are eligible to buy.
Pass when no ineligible product recommendation appears in the ranking.

steps.title: Apply the suppression rules before release
sop: Apply suppression for do-not-contact, opt-out, deceased, in-litigation, and open-complaint records.
Apply suppression to both the retention and cross-sell lists.
Log the count suppressed by each category.
Done when all five suppression categories are applied and counted.
verify: Query the released lists for records carrying any suppression flag.
Pass when the query returns zero records.

steps.title: Cap the lists to the volume distribution and marketing can action
sop: Confirm the volume distribution and marketing can genuinely action in the period.
Cap each list at that volume taking the highest-ranked records.
Record the cap applied and the records held back.
Done when both lists are capped to the actionable volume.
verify: Compare the released list volumes against the agreed capacity.
Pass when neither list exceeds the agreed capacity.

steps.title: Add the inclusion reason to every list record
sop: Add the reason each customer is on the list in business language.
Show the driver behind the churn risk or the cross-sell recommendation.
Avoid exposing raw model feature names on the list.
Done when every list record carries a readable inclusion reason.
verify: Sample list records and read the inclusion reasons.
Pass when every sampled reason is readable without model knowledge.

steps.title: Stamp and release the lists with generation metadata
sop: Stamp each list with its generation date, the model versions used, and the owning team.
Store the lists in the governed schema ready for CRM publication.
Record the suppression and cap results in the generation log.
Done when the lists are stamped, stored, and logged.
verify: Open the generation log and check date, model versions, and owner are recorded.
Pass when all three are recorded for both lists.

generic.Defined scope/population: Customers grouped by segment and product-line combination for the lifetime value calculation.
generic.In-scope period: The historical persistency period used to derive retention curves for the calculation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Expected tenure, margin per year, discount rate, and cell count populated per cell.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cell customer counts sum to the total customer population in scope.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: CLV calculation workbook retained with assumptions and a dated version stamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cells below the minimum sample size logged and suppressed from publication.
generic.Test population: The CLV results by segment and product-line combination for the current period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when no published cell sits below the agreed minimum sample size.
generic.Exception handling path: Data Analyst merges or suppresses cells that fall below the minimum sample size.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: CLV computed by segment and product line with a published definition and assumptions.
generic.Evidence location: CLV workbook in SharePoint with the BI report and the business glossary entry.

steps.title: Define the CLV formula components and assumptions
sop: Define expected tenure, margin per year, and the discount rate used in the formula.
Document the source and rationale for each assumption.
Agree the formula with the Customer Insights Lead before calculation.
Done when the formula and its assumptions are documented and agreed.
verify: Check every formula component has a documented source.
Pass when no component is left without a source.

steps.title: Source retention curves from actual historical persistency
sop: Derive retention curves by segment and product line from actual historical persistency.
Avoid using assumed retention where actual history exists.
Record the history period the curves are derived from.
Done when retention curves are derived from actual persistency data.
verify: Compare a derived curve against the observed persistency for that cell.
Pass when the curve matches the observed persistency.

steps.title: Calculate CLV by segment and product line in Excel
sop: Calculate CLV for every segment and product-line combination.
Show the customer count behind each calculated cell.
Suppress cells below the minimum sample size rather than publishing them.
Done when CLV is calculated and low-volume cells are suppressed.
verify: Check the customer counts across cells sum to the in-scope population.
Pass when the cell counts reconcile to the population.

steps.title: Sense-check CLV against observed multi-year premium
sop: Sample long-tenure customers and sum their actual multi-year premium.
Compare the observed total against the CLV estimate for their cell.
Investigate and record any material divergence.
Done when the sense-check is complete and divergences are recorded.
verify: Check the sampled comparison covers more than one segment.
Pass when the sample spans multiple segments and divergences are explained.

steps.title: Review the CLV results with the Customer Insights Lead
sop: Review the CLV results and the assumptions behind them.
Challenge any cell whose value is implausible against the segment profile.
Record the review outcome and required changes.
Done when the review is complete and changes are recorded.
verify: Check every challenged cell shows a resolution.
Pass when no challenged cell is left unresolved.

steps.title: Publish the CLV definition to the business glossary
sop: Publish the CLV definition and its assumptions to the business glossary.
Link the glossary entry from the BI report showing CLV.
Confirm downstream reporting references the published definition.
Done when the definition is published and linked from the report.
verify: Follow the glossary link from the BI report.
Pass when the link resolves to the published CLV definition.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policies and customers due for renewal in the period, by segment and product.
generic.In-scope period: The current reporting period with the trailing twelve-month trend alongside.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Retention rate, churn rate, and churn type split populated per segment and product.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: In-force and non-renewal counts reconcile to the policy administration system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calculation workbook retained with the data as-of date and glossary definition version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Segments failing the reconciliation logged with the cause and correction applied.
generic.Test population: The retention and churn rates published for the current period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when rates reconcile to the policy system and use the published glossary definition.
generic.Exception handling path: Data Analyst corrects the calculation and republishes before the figures are used.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Rates published by segment and product with reconciliation to the policy system.
generic.Evidence location: BI retention report with the calculation workbook and glossary definition entry.

steps.title: Confirm the retention definition against the business glossary
sop: Read the published retention definition from the business glossary.
Confirm the calculation will follow that definition exactly.
Record the glossary version being used for this period.
Done when the definition is confirmed and its version recorded.
verify: Compare the calculation logic against the glossary definition.
Pass when the logic matches the published definition.

steps.title: Calculate retention and churn rates by segment and product
sop: Calculate policy and customer retention rates by segment and product for the period.
Calculate the corresponding churn rates on the same base.
Show the denominator used for every rate.
Done when rates are calculated for every segment and product cell.
verify: Check each rate cell shows its denominator.

Record the taxonomy version used for the run.

Pass when the query returns zero records.

steps.title: Manually review a sample and measure coding agreement

steps.title: Route low-confidence responses to the manual review queue
