generic.Test population: The survey responses analysed for NPS and CSAT drivers in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when no segment-level driver is reported below the minimum response volume.
generic.Exception handling path: Data Analyst suppresses the segment result and reports it at the aggregate level only.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Driver analysis with ranked drivers, explained variation, and stated method.
generic.Evidence location: Driver analysis workbook in SharePoint with the BI report and lakehouse extract.

steps.title: Assemble touchpoint ratings and operational measures in the lakehouse
sop: Assemble the touchpoint experience ratings for respondents in the period.
Join the relevant operational measures such as handling time and first contact resolution.
Record the respondent count and the joined measure coverage.
Done when the analysis dataset is assembled with coverage recorded.
verify: Reconcile the respondent count to the survey response count for the period.
Pass when the counts reconcile.

steps.title: Run the driver analysis against overall NPS and CSAT
sop: Run the driver analysis relating touchpoint ratings and operational measures to overall NPS and CSAT.
Record the method used and its assumptions.
Retain the model output for reproducibility.
Done when the driver analysis has been run and the output retained.
verify: Check the recorded method allows the analysis to be reproduced.
Pass when a rerun with the recorded method reproduces the result.

steps.title: Rank drivers by strength and report explained variation
sop: Rank the drivers by strength of association with the outcome score.
Report the share of score variation each driver explains.
Show the drivers that explain little so they can be deprioritised.
Done when every driver carries a rank and an explained variation share.
verify: Check the explained variation shares are reported for every ranked driver.
Pass when no ranked driver is missing its share.

steps.title: Check response volume before reporting segment-level drivers
sop: Check the response volume in each segment before reporting segment drivers.
Suppress segments below the minimum response volume.
Report those segments only at the aggregate level.
Done when every reported segment meets the minimum volume.
verify: Query the reported segments for any below the minimum volume.
Pass when the query returns no segments.

steps.title: State the association limitation explicitly in the output
sop: State that the drivers are associations rather than proven causes.
Note where a causal claim cannot be supported by the design.
Place the statement on the face of the output rather than in an appendix.
Done when the limitation statement appears on the output.
verify: Read the output front page for the association limitation statement.
Pass when the statement is visible without opening the appendix.

steps.title: Hand the top drivers to the prioritisation step
sop: Document the top drivers with their ranks and explained variation.
Hand them to the prioritisation step as scoring inputs.
Publish the analysis to the customer insight workspace.
Done when the drivers are documented, handed on, and published.
verify: Check the prioritisation scoring inputs match the published top drivers.
Pass when the Customer Insights Lead confirms the inputs match.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every agreed experience remediation action held in the tracking register.
generic.In-scope period: The delivery period covered by the current tracking cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Owner, target date, status, and expected outcome populated on every open action.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Register action count matches the actions approved in the executive decision record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Implementation evidence retained against each closed action with the closure date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Overdue actions logged with the escalation and the revised target date.
generic.Test population: The remediation action register as at the current tracking cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when no action is marked complete without attached evidence of implementation.
generic.Exception handling path: Customer Insights Lead reopens the action when the evidence does not support closure.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Register current with status, owner, and target date on every open action.
generic.Evidence location: Remediation register in SharePoint with the BI status view and evidence attachments.

steps.title: Log every agreed action in the tracking register
sop: Log each approved remediation action in the register.
Record the owner, target date, and expected outcome for each.
Link the register entry to the executive decision record.
Done when every approved action exists in the register with all three fields.
verify: Reconcile the register action count to the executive decision record.
Pass when every approved action appears in the register.

steps.title: Update action status on the agreed cadence
sop: Collect status updates from action owners on the agreed cadence.
Update the register status and the expected completion date.
Flag actions that have slipped past their target date.
Done when every open action has a current status for the cycle.
verify: Check the register for open actions without a current-cycle status.
Pass when every open action carries a current status.

steps.title: Require implementation evidence before marking an action complete
sop: Require evidence of implementation before an action is marked complete.
Reject owner assertion without supporting evidence.
Attach the evidence to the register entry at closure.
Done when every closed action carries attached implementation evidence.
verify: Open a sample of closed actions and check for attached evidence.
Pass when every sampled closure has evidence attached.

steps.title: Escalate overdue actions to the accountable executive owner
sop: Identify actions overdue beyond the agreed tolerance.
Escalate each to the accountable executive owner with the delay reason.
Record the escalation and any revised target date.
Done when every overdue action has been escalated and recorded.
verify: Check each overdue action carries a recorded escalation.
Pass when no overdue action is left unescalated.

steps.title: Publish the register status view in the BI platform
sop: Publish the status view showing open, overdue, and completed actions.
Show the owner and target date on the view.
Refresh the view on the agreed tracking cadence.
Done when the status view is live and refreshed for the cycle.
verify: Open the status view and compare the counts against the register.
Pass when the view and the register agree.

steps.title: Pass closed actions to the impact measurement step
sop: Pass each closed action to the impact measurement step before it leaves the register.
Record the handover date on the register entry.
Keep the action visible until its impact has been measured.
Done when every closed action has been handed to impact measurement.
verify: Check each closed action shows a handover to impact measurement.
Pass when the Customer Experience Lead confirms no closure skipped the handover.
